Maya: Hey team — prepping a compact 2-day enablement sprint for HelioHealth next week. Need to lock two office-hours blocks (90m each) that work for CET primary attendees + some PST engineers. Also flagged as a 'renewal watch' (low recent usage) so want Product + Ops briefed. Can we coordinate times and a snackable agenda?

Jordan: +1. Suggest Tue 14:00-15:30 CET (13:00-14:30 UTC) and Wed 08:00-09:30 PST (16:00-17:30 UTC). Those give overlap for EMEA and US. @Maya does that align with their calendar? :thinking_face:

Olivia: (HelioHealth) Wed PST is best for our infra folks. Tue CET okay if it's earlier in the day. We can do recordings.

Lee: I can cover migration checklist + Dedicated pool runbook. Will prepare a 15-min pre-read and a short demo.

Maya: Perfect. Draft agenda below — keep it focused so it's easy for a product/business contact to join for part of session.

Maya: ```
Day 1 (Tue CET) - 90m
- 05m intro + goal alignment
- 20m onboarding checklist & account health signal review
- 30m hands-on workspace + token/keys walkthrough
- 25m quick-run: simple inference + capture logs
- 10m action items / owners

Day 2 (Wed PST) - 90m
- 10m recap of day 1 + metrics we care about
- 30m live run: Dedicated pool migration (Lee)
- 35m perf tuning: batching, KV cache, quantization tips (Jordan)
- 15m Q&A + next steps (recording + postmortem)
```

Jordan: I like it. Add a 5-min slot to surface renewal concerns and quick wins (cost reduction levers) so the account rep has something to reference in their renewal notes.

Olivia: Can we get the pre-read by Monday EOD? If Helio team's testers can skim, they'll hit the ground running Wed. Also please enable captions on recording.

SamBot: Calendar invite draft created: https://cal.com/redwood/helio-sprint — propose times attached. Invite will auto-adjust by timezone.

Maya: Action items: Jordan -> send calendar invites + include Zoom + recording settings; Lee -> pre-read + demo repo link by Mon EOD; Maya -> compile 10-item prompt test set + ops playbook snippet; Olivia -> confirm attendees list by Monday morning.

Jordan: Sending invites now. Included agenda and a short poll: "Prefer Tue morning CET or Tue late-afternoon?" :ballot_box_with_ballot:

Lee: Pre-read link (draft): https://drive.redwood.local/helio/pre-read-v1 — will update with demo commands.

Olivia: Confirmed 6 engineers for Wed, 2 product owners for Tue (may join for 30m). We want the recording. :thumbsup:

Maya: Great — I'll enable captions and share a follow-up doc with meeting notes + action tracker after Day 1. Also noting this is a renewal-watch account; please flag any blockers during the sprint so CS can triage ASAP.

Jordan: Invite sent. Added reminder 24h and 1h before. :calendar:

Lee: Will upload demo image and minimal reproduce steps by Mon 18:00 CET.

SamBot: Reminder set for participants at Tue 13:00 UTC (24h before).

Maya: Thanks all — short and focused. If anything changes ping here. :white_check_mark:

Olivia: Thanks team — looking forward to it.
